correctness.rationale: Separated Jacobian ideals identify the Milnor algebra with A_f tensor k, and multiplication by F_k with the nilpotent Kronecker sum. Under a chosen sl2 raising representation of each Jordan block, the number of cokernel generators equals the coefficient at weights zero and one of chi^k. The uniform finite-support random weight has variance sigma², and the lattice local CLT with parity/span adjustment gives the exact sqrt(k) constant. For plane curves Briançon–Skoda f² in J_f gives N²=0; the explicit x⁴+y⁵+x²y³ example has mu=12,tau=11. Independently assembled small tensor matrices and character coefficient counts agreed. This finite arithmetic does not establish the all-k theorem or local limit.
